correctness.rationale: For GP(8,3), the C++17 program independently generates all 96 graph automorphisms, all 1090 nonempty independent faces and 24875 canonical barycentric chain-orbit cells. It checks 12114 free-face collapses and closes the residual 647-cell structure. Exact integer Smith normal forms on signed residual cellular boundaries have ranks (13,70,144,96), zero boundary compositions, all nonunit factors equal 1 except one factor 2 in degree four, giving reduced integral H3=Z/2 and nothing else. The full 214-triangle fundamental-group presentation on 70 generators reduces by three valid unit-relator waves to the trivial group. The homological Hurewicz theorem and the simply connected homological Whitehead theorem then identify the degree-two Moore attachment; exact assumptions, quantifiers, boundaries and distinction from Borel quotient are stated in RESULT.md. The generator program and exact data are included and replayed.
